integrity: Analytic proof with exact symbolic checks and illustrative finite orbit tests. No independent scientific validation; attribution of introduced model and cusp preserved.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional strictly positive Ludwig model and fixed time steps only; exact cusp expansion only at (r,k)=(3sqrt(3)/8,3sqrt(3)); no stochastic or coupled extension, no uniform near-cusp asymptotics, no analytic value of additive constant. Historical novelty provisional.
title: Global convergence and a tunable logarithmic cusp law for a tropical Ludwig map
